0x001B1C0C.name: SceneResource_RunMode17Service
0x001B1C0C.body: Writes 0x17 to SCENE_RESOURCE_MODE, runs the actor animation and render submission passes, calls the local scene-resource service tail, and invokes VDP_RunPatternServiceFrames. If INTERACTION_RESOURCE_PROGRESS_COUNTER is not the ASCII string 000, it runs the frame/resource service and the adjacent VDP command tail. A SCENE_VDP_UPDATE_FLAG gate prepares/sends the scene audio command before the function returns.

0x001B1D00.name: SceneResource_InitializeMode17Service
0x001B1D00.body: Clears the scene-resource palette/transition and actor state, programs the VDP setup registers, acquires and releases the Z80 bus around the VDP command-pointer handoff, calls SceneResource_RunMode17Service, starts the palette transition, and restores the display register before returning.

other_addresses.0x00FFF0F8: set at setup entry as an unnamed presentation-state byte
other_addresses.0x00FFF0D3: set immediately before the mode-0x17 service call as an unnamed status byte

limitations: No direct static caller was recovered for the 0x001B1D00 entry; it may be reached through an indirect or externally selected presentation path.
The exact user-visible identity of mode 0x17 remains unresolved; the names describe the explicit mode byte and operations only.
conclusion: The adjacent blocks are complete mode-0x17 scene-resource service/setup functions with exact 0xD8-byte boundaries. Their local contracts are established without claiming a more specific presentation identity.
